title: country-place-matrix: cross-checked country, address, telephone and timezone reference data for 257 selectors
description:
A cross-checked reference of country, territory, address, telephone and timezone metadata for 257 country and territory selectors (250 canonical identities), with the scripts that build it from pinned public sources and a small PHP library for using it.

It records what Unicode CLDR, the IANA Time Zone Database, CommerceGuys Addressing, Google libphonenumber and GeoNames each say for every selector, where they conflict, and what is still unknown. It includes a generated one-row-per-selector matrix, per-country exception notes, a review of postal references for countries with no dedicated address format, and a town-name matcher for text extracted from web pages.

All builds and tests run offline against the pinned inputs. The data is reference evidence and is not a claim of national accuracy.
